subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Paris Agreement Effect
description: A quick, practical guide to The Paris Agreement Effect.

hook.text: 195 nations agreed to limit warming to 1.5°C. That target is now rewriting supply chain rules worldwide.

buildup.text: The Paris Agreement set the global framework for climate action. Countries translate it into national laws.

discovery.text: Those laws create carbon taxes, emission caps, and reporting requirements that directly affect supply chains.

twist.text: Each country implements differently. A global supply chain must navigate dozens of different climate regulations.

climax.text: Companies that align supply chains with Paris goals early avoid regulatory scrambles later.

punchline.text: The Paris Agreement isn't just policy. It's a supply chain mandate.

quiz.question: What did the Paris Agreement set?
options: A global framework to limit warming to 1.5°C
